# Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0517a)

**ID:** Atk S0517a
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Khuddakanikāya (atk-s05)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Suttas
**Title (Pali):** Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā*, traditionally entitled the *Saddhammappakāsinī*, is the commentary on the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* belonging to the Khuddakanikāya commentary collection [Endo 2002; Kragh 2013]. According to Theravāda tradition, the commentary was recast from earlier Old Sinhalese commentaries (*Sīhala-aṭṭhakathā*) [Endo 2002]. In its framing material, the text specifies the reigning king and records the place where the work was compiled [Goonesekere 1967]. Like the *Sammohavinodanī*, the text contains instances where the commentator's interpretations diverge from or appear contradictory to the canonical root text [Adikaram 1946].

In modern scholarship and editions, the text was edited for the Pali Text Society by C. V. Joshi, published in Sri Lanka in the Simon Hewavitarne Bequest series (Hevavitarana edition), and printed in Burma in the Sixth Buddhist Council edition [Kragh 2013; Khemananda 1993; SI TI LA 2014]. Theravāda scholars cite the work for foundational philosophical definitions, including its semantic analysis of *mettā* (loving-kindness) shared with the *Visuddhimagga* and *Atthasālinī* [SI TI LA 2014], its epistemological analyses of *paratoghosa* and reflective knowledge (*paccavekkhaṇa-ñāṇa*) [Khemananda 1993], and its exegesis on emptiness (*suññatā*) [Vélez de Cea].

Text-reuse analysis in DharmaNexus shows over 111,000 matches shared across 646 Pali texts, reflecting the commentary's deep scholastic integration [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual partners are Buddhaghosa's *Visuddhimagga*, Khuddakanikāya commentaries such as the *Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā* and *Cūḷaniddesa-aṭṭhakathā*, Abhidhamma commentaries including the *Vibhaṅga-aṭṭhakathā* and *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā*, and the root *Ñāṇakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* itself [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher are identified [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Visuddhimaggo (Dutiyo bhāgo) (Anya E0102n) (§1363_1–1380 ↔ §185_2–215_8); Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0515a) (§850_6–907_15 ↔ §629_4–696_5); Vibhaṅga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh02a) (§679_3–692_8 ↔ §514_0–527_7); Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0201a) (§861_1–883_12 ↔ §299_8–318_11); Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh01a) (§783_0–788_10 ↔ §1463_0–1470_0); Visuddhimaggo (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0101n) (§758_0–773_11 ↔ §1000_0–1015_12); Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi (Tika Abh09t) (§2213_1–2214_4 ↔ §2107_0–2108_3); Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin01a) (§783_0–788_10 ↔ §684_0–690_0)
